seed.title: Avernum 5
seed.note: Windows-only (mac:false); Spiderweb engine sibling of Avernum 4/6 -- expected minimal steam_api footprint (Init/Shutdown). Added as the immediately-testable Gate 3 target: not previously installed, so a fresh GameLib install exercises the full bridge install path (Avernum 6/HOARD are blocked by D-UAT-24-02, already-installed via non-bridge paths). Import coverage confirmed via 24-05 importScan at install. 51-UAT item 2 (2026-10-22, fresh Mac): launches through its own per-game bottle with real identity and Mac Steam In-Game (bridge path PASS); the item recorded an issue for helper teardown on first launch, not for this title. Operator observation: the game is not really playable under wine (in-game menu disappears) -- a wine-level limitation, kept in seed by operator decision.

seed.title: The Age of Decadence
seed.note: Windows-only; ships both AoD.exe (x86) and AoD64.exe (x64). Played through the bridge on its x64 runtime-lookup path (SteamInternal_CreateInterface, like ELEX), not through bare accessors: D-51-14 replacement anchor chosen by operator decision 2026-10-23. 51-UAT item 18: per-game bottle GameLibSteamBridge-230070, steam_api64.dll placed == SHIM64 (848896 bytes), HELLO shim attached appid=230070, reached main menu and in-game, Mac Steam In-Game, 452s of play. Its required set includes SteamApps (STEAMAPPS_INTERFACE_VERSION008), SteamUserStats (011) and SteamRemoteStorage (013, stubbed).

knownBad.title: XCOM: Enemy Unknown
knownBad.note: 51-UAT item 5 (2026-10-22): scan clean and the shim loads, but XComGame.exe reads PE resources STEAM_SPLIT_GUID/STEAM_GUIDD/STEAM_MINSTANCE, writes XComGame.exe.<pid>.STEAMSTART, idles ~30s and exits without ever calling SteamAPI_Init -- Steam CEG waiting for a Windows Steam client a bridge bottle cannot provide. Inferred from a CrossOver --cx-log trace; CEG diagnosis CONFIRMED by 51-UAT item 17 (2026-10-23): under the bottled Windows Steam client XCOM: Enemy Within reaches its main menu, so CEG needs a Windows Steam client. The base Enemy Unknown build then crashes after its shell starts loading, a Wine-level crash CrossOver rates 3 stars; reason stays drm-wrapped because the bridge cannot satisfy CEG.

knownBad.title: HOARD
knownBad.note: 51-UAT item 4 (2026-10-22, packaged debug bundle, fresh Mac): the bridge half passed (per-game bottle GameLibSteamBridge-63000, LISTEN/INIT/HELLO for appid 63000, stubbed-interface notice shown) but Reuben.exe shows a crash dialog before reaching single-player. The operator confirms this is the same crash Hoard has always had under CrossOver, before the bridge existed: a Wine-level incompatibility, not a bridge defect. Part B (USER/FRIENDS dispatch) never observed. Retiring Hoard as the D-51-14 acceptance anchor is an operator decision recorded by 51-28.

knownBad.title: ELEX
knownBad.note: 51-UAT item 15 (2026-10-23, packaged debug bundle): the bridge half passed with the wired Win64 shim (per-game bottle GameLibSteamBridge-411300, placed steam_api64.dll 848896 bytes == SHIM64, HELLO shim attached appid=411300, no not-subscribed error, the stubbed-interface notice no longer lists SteamUser/SteamUtils/SteamApps/SteamFriends) but ELEX hangs on its loading screen and never reaches the main menu. The operator rates ELEX does-not-run; the cause past the bridge handshake is not diagnosed.
